names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 2 iunie, «Sfântul Ierarh Nichifor, Patriarhul Constantinopolului».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 2 Ιουνίου, «Άγιος Νικηφόρος ο Ομολογητής Πατριάρχης Κωνσταντινούπολης», with the rank words left off.

Read out of the Ohrid Prologue's first heading for the Julian 2 June on pravoslavno.rs, „Свети Никифор Исповедник, патријарх цариградски.“, with Свети left off, which is not a rank, with the rank word Исповедник left off, and with the see патријарх цариградски left off as well. The Julian 13 March heading, „Свети Никифор, патријарх цариградски.“, leaves the same bare forename. Nothing on either page gives an epithet, so the bare form is what the source gives and it folds with `nicephorus-of-antioch`.

A BARE FORENAME, and deliberately. Name page 1625 heads him «Святитель Никифор, I Патриарх Константинопольский» — the rank before the comma and, after it, the regnal numeral and the see, which are the office this folder already carries and not name words. So «Никифор» is the whole of the name the calendar gives, and BRIEF-RUSSIAN §2's preference for a fuller form has nothing to work with. The bare string costs no fold: 'никифор' is ALREADY a four-member fold that corpus-gate.mjs has marked READ — nicephorus-4-may, nicephorus-companion-of-zebinas, nicephorus-of-antioch and this folder — because the Serbian wave stored the identical string here, so this `ru` row joins a fold it is already in and the key's membership does not move. Verified against the gate's own fold() and against the plain gate's collision row before it was written.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 2 июня ст. ст. — «Свт. Никифора исп., патриарха Константинопольского (828).»

attestations.note: The day's first entry of five, «Свт. Никифора исп., патриарха Константинопольского (828).». «исп.» is исповедник, the confessor, which this folder already carries in `types`; «патриарха Константинопольского» is the `Patriarch of Constantinople` already in `office`; and 828 is the year the folder already holds. The Romanian, Greek and Serbian rows all stand on this same 2 June, so the identification is as firm as this corpus gets. The day page prints THREE hymns under his name — a troparion, an «Ин тропарь» and a kontakion — and all three are added; the first is the common of a hierarch with his name filled into it, which BRIEF.md §4 makes his own service and not a mis-hang. `id1625`, the index of his lives, was NOT followed, so nothing of his life is touched here. azbyka.ru was not read.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 2 iunie — «Sfântul Ierarh Nichifor, Patriarhul Constantinopolului»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 2ης Ιουνίου — «Άγιος Νικηφόρος ο Ομολογητής Πατριάρχης Κωνσταντινούπολης»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 2 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing and the same day as the folder's Romanian row. It is plainly the same man: the patriarch of Constantinople who contended for the icons, was driven from his throne by Leo V the Armenian and died in exile. saint.gr dates him «(758 - 822)», which doxologia's life did not; the Greek page also links a separate entry for the translation of his relics and one for the synaxis of all the archbishops and patriarchs of Constantinople, and neither was opened for this draft. Three hymns are taken from the page. A fourth text, a μεγαλυνάριον, is printed there and is not taken: the schema holds a troparion and a kontakion and nothing else.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 15.06.2026 (2. јун ст. ст.) — „Свети Никифор Исповедник, патријарх цариградски.“

attestations.note: Read while reading the Julian 13 March, whose first entry is this same patriarch — and that entry says in its own words which day is which: „Главно празновање овога великог јерарха бива 2. јуна, а 13. марта празнује се откриће и пренос његових нетљених моштију.“ So the Julian 2 June page was opened as well, and it keeps him as its first and fullest entry, „Свети Никифор Исповедник, патријарх цариградски.“, with the long life this folder's closing paragraphs now summarise. The row is therefore the Julian 2 June, the same menologion day as this folder's Romanian and Greek rows, and the Julian 13 March is the second day: the Prologue keeps there the uncovering and translation of his incorrupt relics, and by the settled rule one church gets one row, so the Serbian 13 March renders him nowhere. The Prologue adds that he was driven from Constantinople on 13 March and that his relics were brought into the capital on 13 March again, nineteen years later. It dates his repose 827, where this folder holds 822 from saint.gr; the sourced year is left standing and the disagreement is recorded here rather than resolved. The stored Serbian form is the bare forename, because both headings give only the rank words Свети and Исповедник, which this folder's `types` already carry, and the see патријарх цариградски, which belongs in `office`; the bare „Никифор“ therefore folds with `nicephorus-of-antioch`, which holds the same bare form off its own Julian 9 February heading, and that fold is recorded as deliberate. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion on either day.

hymns.text: Îndreptător credinţei şi chip blândeţilor, învăţător înfrânării te-a arătat pe tine turmei tale adevărul lucrurilor. Pentru aceasta ai câştigat cu smerenia cele înalte, cu sărăcia cele bogate. Părinte Ierarhe Nichifor, roagă pe Hristos Dumnezeu ca să mântuiască sufletele noastre.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Ierarh Nichifor Mărturisitorul, Patriarhul Constantinopolului; the text is the common of a hierarch with his name set in it.

english.text: A rule of faith and an image of meekness, a teacher of abstinence: so did the truth of things show thee to thy flock. Therefore thou hast gained by humility the things on high, and by poverty the things that are rich. Father and hierarch Nikephoros, pray to Christ God that our souls may be saved.

hymns.text: Νίκην ἤνεγκε, τὴ Ἐκκλησία, ἡ σὴ ἔνθεος, ὁμολογία, Νικηφόρε Ἱεράρχα θεόληπτε• τὴν γὰρ Εἰκόνα τοῦ Λόγου σεβόμενος, ὑπερορία ἀδίκως ὠμίλησας. Πάτερ Ὅσιε, Χριστὸν τὸν Θεὸν ἱκέτευε, δωρήσασθαι ἠμὶν τὸ μέγα ἔλεος.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον (Κατέβασμα), Ἦχος γ’, Θείας πίστεως, the first of two apolytikia on the page of «Άγιος Νικηφόρος ο Ομολογητής Πατριάρχης Κωνσταντινούπολης»

english.text: Your godly confession brought victory to the Church, O God-inspired hierarch Nikephoros; for venerating the image of the Word you were unjustly made to dwell in banishment. Venerable father, entreat Christ our God to grant us his great mercy.

hymns.text: Κανόνα πίστεως, καὶ εἰκόνα πραότητος, ἐγκρατείας διδάσκαλον, ἀνέδειξε σε τῇ ποίμνῃ σου, ἡ τῶν πραγμάτων ἀλήθεια· διὰ τοῦτο ἐκτήσω τῇ ταπεινώσει τὰ ὑψηλά, τῇ πτωχείᾳ τὰ πλούσια. Πάτερ Ἱεράρχα Νικηφόρε, πρέσβευε Χριστῷ τῷ θεῷ, σωθῆναι τὰς ψυχὰς ἡμῶν.

source.text: saint.gr, Έτερον Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος δ’, the second of two apolytikia on the page of «Άγιος Νικηφόρος ο Ομολογητής Πατριάρχης Κωνσταντινούπολης». It is the common of a hierarch, sung to other bishops with their own names in the last line, and the page prints it with his; so it is taken as his service, as the brief's ruling on a common requires.

english.text: The truth of things has shown you to your flock as a rule of faith, an icon of gentleness and a teacher of temperance; and so by humility you gained the heights, and by poverty riches. Father and hierarch Nikephoros, intercede with Christ our God that our souls may be saved.

hymns.text: Τὸν τῆς νίκης στέφανον, ὢ Νικηφόρε, οὐρανόθεν σήμερον, ὡς εἰληφῶς παρὰ Θεοῦ, σῷζε τοὺς πίστει τιμώντας σέ, ὡς Ἱεράρχην ὁμοὺ καὶ Διδάσκαλον.

source.text: saint.gr, Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος δ’, Ἐπεφάνης σήμερον, on the page of «Άγιος Νικηφόρος ο Ομολογητής Πατριάρχης Κωνσταντινούπολης»

english.text: Having received today from heaven the crown of victory from God, O Nikephoros, save those who honour you in faith as hierarch and teacher alike.

hymns.text: Правило веры и образ кротости,/ воздержания учителя/ яви тя стаду твоему/ Яже вещей Истина:/ сего ради стяжал еси смирением высокая,/ нищетою богатая,/ отче Никифоре,/ моли Христа Бога// спастися душам нашим.

source.text: days.pravoslavie.ru, «Тропарь святителя Никифора», глас 4, under «Молитвы» on the day page for 2 июня ст. ст.. It is the common of a hierarch — the same text the Church sings to Nicholas of Myra and to other bishops — with the saint's name filled into its vocative, «отче Никифоре», so it is his own service and not a proper belonging to somebody else (BRIEF.md §4).

english.text: The Truth of things hath shown thee to thy flock as a rule of faith, an image of meekness and a teacher of abstinence; wherefore thou hast gained the heights by humility and riches by poverty. O father Nicephorus, pray thou to Christ God that our souls be saved.

hymns.text: Иже первороднаго Царства отец,/ правоверный службы истинный пастырь бысть, преподобне,/ Царя града, Церкви всех матере явися светильник, Никифоре,/ моли Христа Бога,/ да спасет души наша.

source.text: days.pravoslavie.ru, «Ин тропарь святителя Никифора», глас 4, under «Молитвы» on the day page for 2 июня ст. ст.. «Ин тропарь» is this source's way of printing a second troparion for the same saint, and this one names him in the vocative.

english.text: O father of the first-born Kingdom, thou wast a true shepherd of the right-believing worship, O venerable one; thou wast shown forth a lamp of the City of the King and of the Church that is mother of all, O Nicephorus: pray thou to Christ God that He save our souls.

hymns.text: Победы венец с Небесе,/ о Никифоре преславне,/ яко прием от Бога,/ спасай верою почитающия тя,// яко священноначальника Христова и учителя.

source.text: days.pravoslavie.ru, «Кондак святителя Никифора», глас 4, under «Молитвы» on the day page for 2 июня ст. ст.. It names him in the vocative.

english.text: Having received from God a crown of victory out of heaven, O most glorious Nicephorus, save those who honour thee with faith, inasmuch as thou art a hierarch and teacher of Christ.

birth.note: saint.gr's head line reads «Αγιος Νικηφορος ο Ομολογητης Πατριαρχης Κωνσταντινουπολης (758 - 822)» and the life says he was born at Constantinople in 758. doxologia.ro's life, which this folder was built from, printed no year at all.

death.note: saint.gr says he gave up his spirit «στις 2 Ιουνίου 822 μ.Χ.», on 2 June 822.
